command.template: cd <sdk>; export RUSTUP_HOME=<isolated>/rustup-home KANI_HOME=<isolated>/kani-home CARGO_HOME=<isolated>/cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated>/target; cargo-kani --manifest-path rust/crates/actors/Cargo.toml --package acyclic-actors --harness domain::kani_proofs::positive_u64_constructor_accepts_exactly_nonzero_values --exact --default-unwind 1 -j1

harnesses.obligation: For every symbolic u64, PositiveU64::new(value) succeeds exactly when value is nonzero, preserves the exact value through get(), and returns Contract(InvalidArgument) exactly for zero.
harnesses.name: domain::kani_proofs::positive_u64_constructor_accepts_exactly_nonzero_values

evidence.unsupported_constructs: Kani reported no selected harness failure; the crate-level run retained the known caller_location and foreign-function reachability warnings.

scope.formal: Only the pure PositiveU64 constructor and accessor invariant is proved for symbolic u64 values; this receipt says nothing about arbitrary Vec-based digest construction, wire identity, codecs, native loading, package installation, network transport, streaming, cancellation, recovery, or platform behavior.
scope.runtime_followups: Those integration properties remain runtime/artifact obligations.
